raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Draft alternative for #8826 and #8828. **This overlaps the existing #8827 (32-thread dispatch) and #8830 (tail-row bounds) PRs.** No exclusive claim or maintainer approval is asserted. Both existing PRs were open when this draft was submitted.

For small inference normalization inputs, the launchers omit the 32-thread group needed for FP32 hidden sizes 65–128, and partially filled multi-row blocks can access rows past the tensor boundary. This patch adds the missing dispatch and bounds logical rows before tensor offsets, global loads and stores in the v1 LayerNorm/residual LayerNorm/RMSNorm/pre-RMSNorm kernels. It keeps the multi-row schedule and reduction participation.

## Remote validation by Codex

Source baseline: `9a31ccf49fcd9ff93d0ec1ee04335a7165e86d0f`. One NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, driver 580.178.04; Python 3.11.17, PyTorch 2.6.0+cu124, CUDA compiler 12.9. Separate JIT extension directories were used for baseline and patched CUDA sources.

- The same added FP32 dispatch regressions fail on unchanged kernels: 4 failures. The original tail-row cases report 20 Compute Sanitizer errors (exit 86).
- Patched focused checks: **98 passed, 484 deselected**, rerun on the final remote worktree before submission.
- Patched FP32/FP16/BF16 tail cases: **6 passed, zero Compute Sanitizer errors** with CUDA memory caching disabled. Residual cases invoke the actual CUDA bindings, not the PyTorch high-level fallback.
- Applicable changed-file pre-commit checks and `git diff --check` pass.

Commands:
```bash
python -m pytest -q -m inference_ops tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_layer_norm.py tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_rms_norm.py -k 'subblock_ or 384'
PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING=1 compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --error-exitcode 86 python -m pytest -q -m inference_ops tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_layer_norm.py tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_rms_norm.py -k subblock_tail_rows
python -m pre_commit run --files csrc/transformer/inference/csrc/layer_norm.cu csrc/transformer/inference/csrc/rms_norm.cu tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_layer_norm.py tests/unit/ops/transformer/inference/test_rms_norm.py
```

Compatibility scope: v1 CUDA inference normalization, FP32/FP16/BF16 on one RTX 4070. No end-to-end model inference, convergence, throughput, peak-memory benchmark, multi-GPU or non-CUDA accelerator coverage is claimed. ZeRO/offload/training behavior was not exercised. Sibling v2/quantization paths were inspected only, not modified or device-validated.

As an overlap check, the exact #8830 CUDA source (`95c8f13`) also passes our same six tail cases with zero memcheck errors; this draft does not claim those existing proposals are inadequate.

## Human review and DCO

Codex prepared the patch, tests, remote validation, description and this draft on behalf of @wpyaoxueros at the contributor's explicit request. Huashuo Lei has confirmed that he reviewed and understood the final changes and personally ran the relevant remote tests. He also explicitly confirmed agreement to DCO 1.1 and authorized adding his `Signed-off-by` and updating this existing PR. Codex performed the commit-message update under that authorization; the code tree is unchanged.

This remains a draft. The overlap with #8827/#8830 and the validation limits above are unchanged; signing does not claim maintainer acceptance or end-to-end model validation.
